description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class 'NoteController' that exposes CRUD operations for managing notes via HTTP endpoints. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, along with validation error handling. The class interacts with a 'NoteService' and uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: REST controller exposing CRUD operations for notes, handling HTTP requests and responses, and integrating with the NoteService.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes sorted by ID.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID, returning 404 if not found.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided request data.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new data, handling not found errors.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning appropriate status codes.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors for request payloads, returning detailed error information.
